uncertainties: Visible navigation targets were mapped from the authenticated live UI, but each destination page was not opened individually; destination-level permission failures or redirects were therefore not independently proven.

Items labeled New beside an older label were treated as alternate implementations of the same capability and deduplicated; the UI did not explicitly identify whether both versions have functional differences.
The sidebar contains visual separators without visible section names, so their direct-link items are grouped under Main.
Orders Integration was visible only as an Orders page-header shortcut, not as a global sidebar item.
result.summary: The authenticated ADM session exposes a mixed navigation model dominated by a large sidebar, with expandable Leads, Staff, and System groups plus an Orders-specific Integration shortcut. All visible expandable main-navigation groups were inspected, and legacy/new aliases were deduplicated by apparent capability.
